title: Modbus device switched off
summary: A correctly configured device stops answering because it has no power or no link.

sections.heading: Recognize it
sections.body: Requests time out and ping gets no reply, although the configuration matches the documentation and other devices answer.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Go to the device: power, link LED, its own diagnostics. Then verify the connection again.

modeled: Deterministic Modbus TCP client and servers: IPv4 subnet rules, address resolution, unit ID handling of gateways, function 03/04 reads, exceptions 01/02/0B, processing time against the configured timeout, INT and REAL values with word order
approximated: One request at a time per connection
omitted: Writes, other function codes and serial bus timing behind gateways
Byte order inside a register (words are big-endian as the protocol defines)

repair: Restore power or link, then verify
troubleshooting.explanation: When the configuration is right, the problem is at the device or on its link.
